title: Collapse only completion-owned checkpoints from peer deltas
outcome: Completion deduplication removes only the checkpoint generated by that completion and preserves distinct adjacent progress checkpoints.
acceptance: A regression test keeps a substantive checkpoint immediately before completion while collapsing the completion-owned checkpoint.

completion.summary: Peer deltas retain substantive ordinary checkpoints and collapse only canonically bound note/completion capture checkpoints and events, including separate delivery pages and replay. Landed and installed bundle8A.
